_comment: Golden cases for writing an applied default out explicitly: (q) AND field:(...). Read by frontend/src/lib/search-state.test.ts (the reducer's output) and backend/tests/contract/test_frontend_wrap_golden.py (the server parser accepts q and every expected string, and rejects the wrapped form of every refused q). A backslash escapes the next non-space character (spec 02), so a q ending in an odd run of backslashes would escape the closing parenthesis.

cases.expected: (trust) AND track:(main OR datasets_benchmarks OR position OR workshop)
(llm OR (foundation model)) AND track:(main OR datasets_benchmarks OR position OR workshop)
